def factor_dynamic_smooth_vol_expansion_volume_gated(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    intraday_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]
    disloc_ma = intraday_range.rolling(60, min_periods=60).mean()
    disloc_std = intraday_range.rolling(60, min_periods=60).std()
    disloc_z = (intraday_range - disloc_ma) / disloc_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    overnight_gap = (df_copy["open"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() / df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    gap_ma = overnight_gap.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    gap_median = gap_ma.rolling(60, min_periods=60).median()
    high_gap_regime = gap_ma > gap_median
    span_high = 5
    span_low = 10
    ema_high = disloc_z.ewm(span=span_high, min_periods=span_high).mean()
    ema_low = disloc_z.ewm(span=span_low, min_periods=span_low).mean()
    disloc_z_smooth = np.where(high_gap_regime, ema_high, ema_low)
    signal = disloc_z_smooth * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_dynamic_smooth_vol_expansion_volume_gated"] = signal.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_dynamic_smooth_vol_expansion_volume_gated"]
description: Crossover between qualified volatility-expansion-volume-gated (primary mechanism: intraday range z-score, EMA smoothed, volume gated) and rejected volatility-breakout-with-gap (lightweight overnight gap idea). The secondary idea adapts the smoothing EMA span based on overnight gap regime: when recent average gap is elevated (above its 60-day median), use shorter span (5) for faster response; otherwise use longer span (10). This preserves the qualified parent's volume-confirmed volatility expansion strength while adding regime-adaptive smoothing that may improve responsiveness around gap-driven stress.
